_comment: The reference measurement the parse-rate gate is judged against. Run logs are NOT committed (experiments/*/results/ is gitignored); this is the distilled result + provenance. Update it DELIBERATELY, never to make a red run go green.

provenance.commit: 72fc760 (quantifier-determiner fix, on top of 925faa2 definite-referential): added several/many/few/most/both as plural existential determiners + an always-on cross-POS prune that drops the gradable-ADJECTIVE reading of any surface carrying a closed-class determiner reading)
snapshot_lineage: scripts/reseed-lexicon-db.sh --umls-all --snapshot-dir <base>  -> wordnet-umls-2026-07-16-quant  (base; bootstrap incl. axiom ontology:the AND the 5 plural quantifier determiners -- image rebuilt)

NOTE: the default WRN-TUI subset reseed (988 MB) is NOT faithful -- it drops ~2/3 of UMLS and yields spurious cap-only grammar-gaps + missing-lexemes. --umls-all is required to reproduce baseline coverage.

gates.coverage: grammar_gap == 0 and missing_lexeme == 0 — every sentence parses. NON-NEGOTIABLE.
gates.faithfulness: encoded should RISE. Floor set at 7, ONE UNIT BELOW the observed 8 (the reranker drifts ~1 unit between runs even at temperature 0; a baseline set at the peak would flag that drift as a regression). Two of the observed 8 are DETERMINISTIC, traced fixes (each a named sentence AMBIG -> ENCODED, not reranker drift): (1) the definite-referential fix -- 'MSI cancer models did not require the exonuclease activity of WRN', whose only post-rerank ambiguity was the not-exists/exists-not negation-scope dup; (2) the quantifier-determiner fix -- 'MSI contributes to several cancers', where the new `several` determiner + the adjective prune leave only cancer-sense polysemy (1 structural skeleton), which the reranker collapses. The other 6 encodings are reranker sense-collapse and drift; the floor absorbs them.

reproduced.note: temperature:0 pinned. THREE consecutive runs, all grammar-gap 0.

reproducibility.finding: temperature:0 is NOT deterministic. Two live runs of identical code against an identical store differ on ~5% of the CAPPED top-2 — the only part that reaches the parser. encoded moves +/-1 unit between runs. Do not read a one-unit change as signal.
reproducibility.the_only_exact_reproduction: scripts/measure-parse-rate.sh --replay <run>/ranks.json — replays the recorded rankings with no LLM. A replay with misses > 0 is a DIFFERENT experiment.
reproducibility.instrument_caveat: ranks.json records the RERANKER'S CANDIDATE LIST, built BEFORE lookup_span's dedup and cap. It shows what the model was ASKED, not what SEEDED. It cannot tell you how many cap slots a merge freed. (Misread three times on 2026-07-11/12.) The `sems` field makes merges visible — two senses with different labels and the SAME sem are one concept — but the pre-dedup caveat still stands.

history.note: first reference. Cross-lexicon duplicates and function-word junk both present.
cross-lexicon alignment v1 (12,450 merges). readings -4.3%, encoded UNCHANGED — collapsing a duplicate freed a cap slot that the parser immediately refilled.

SENSE ELIMINATION. The ranker may now OMIT an impossible sense, the cap no longer backfills from the rejects, and 132 closed-class entries carry a real core:description (they used to render as BLANK LINES in the prompt, so the model eliminated the determiner `each` and kept UMLS's 'Each (qualifier value)'). encoded 1 -> 4, runtime 330s -> 220s. THE ONLY CHANGE THAT MOVED encoded ALL SESSION.

alignment v2 (26,690 merges, incl. the un-glossed half). readings -0.3% vs v1 — FLAT. Cross-lexicon de-duplication is DONE and is not the lever. What remains is STRUCTURAL: the worst unit is 168 readings over 93 skeletons (coordination + PP attachment), sense~1.8.

alignment v3 (38,389 merges). Two structural fixes: (1) UMLS surfaces LEMMATISED against WordNet, so plural atoms (Genes, Tumours, Therapies) now merge — their entries (e_<CUI>_0) are separate from the singular and were silently unmerged before; (2) one verdict now licenses EVERY surface of a concept, not just the judged one. 26,690 -> 38,389 merges, 51,925 entry rewrites (2.8x v2). readings 2320 -> 2237 (-3.6%), encoded UNCHANGED at 3. grammar-gap 0 held. Predicted the two pure-sense units (MSI tumours: 8->4, Germline: 3->2) would collapse to ENCODED; they dropped but did NOT reach 1. Confirms the standing verdict a THIRD time: alignment reduces reading MULTIPLICITY a few %, never reaches a SINGLE reading. The residual is structural. CAVEAT on the -3.6%: it is NOT drift-controlled — the v2 (2320) and v3 (2237) totals are separate live-reranker runs, so the delta conflates the lexicon change with temp-0 reranker drift, and cap-backfill absorbs part of the dedup (the worst unit's max went UP 128 -> 184). Direction is right, magnitude is soft; to isolate the lexicon effect, replay ONE ranks.json across both snapshots. Also: the prior -v3 measurement (encoded 4) was the STALE v2 .esl loaded under a v3 name (emit was never re-run); the emit+load two-step was fused into scripts/build-alignment-snapshot.sh, and merges.json is now built by a `lexicon-align merges` subcommand instead of an ad-hoc script.

Machine move + dcg-cleanup merge. The merge bundled a dcg module REORGANIZATION (lookup.rs -> parse/, parser.rs -> rules/combinators.rs, packed.rs -> chart/, category.rs split into rules/) with a code/data-consistency fix: conn_list, which the parser (category.rs LIST_CONN) had always CONSTRUCTED, was finally DECLARED on the lexicon:Conn inductive. That declaration changed the compiled lexicon-bootstrap content hash (e11ff807 -> 0298520a), so the 2026-07-12 snapshot no longer resumes (ManifestDrift, fail-closed) and a reseed was required. Full reseed against the post-merge bootstrap -> wordnet-umls-aligned-v3-2026-07-15 (38,389 merges, 51,925 entry rewrites), then measured live: encoded 3, ambiguous 58, open 1, grammar-gap 0, missing-lexeme 0, runtime 257s. REPRODUCES the baseline EXACTLY, on a different machine, confirming (a) the new machine reproduces prior work and (b) the merge is behaviorally neutral on this page (dcg reorg + conn_list together). Provenance repointed from the drifted 2026-07-12 snapshot to this one; the 2026-07-12 snapshots are superseded and safe to prune.

RE-BASELINE. Definite-referential fix. Definite + demonstrative determiners denoted the existential CPS (obj_exists_sem / exists_sem) as a documented first-cut; under negation that spuriously bifurcated into wide-scope (not-exists) vs narrow-scope (exists-not) -- a REAL ambiguity for `a`/`an`, vacuous for a definite's unique referent. Fix: new axiom ontology:the (the iota / definite operator) + referential sems (subject V(the(A)); object TV(the(T), subj)); 12 definite/demonstrative entries repointed; `a`/`an`/`some` + cardinals KEEP the quantifier sems (their scope split is real). The category is unchanged (sem-only edit) so grammar-gap is unchanged by construction; both scope derivations now normalise to one term and felicity::subsume_duplicates collapses them. The bootstrap edit changed the lexicon-bootstrap content hash and invalidated the 07-15 chain -> reseed --umls-all + v3-align -> wordnet-umls-aligned-v3-2026-07-16 (2.8 GB). Witnessed: cap-only grammar-gap 0 + missing-lexeme 0, WRN negation sentence 4->2 (1 structural skeleton, residual is a cross-lexicon `activity` sense dup); reranked encoded 7, ambiguous 54, open 1, grammar-gap 0, runtime 279s. The single traced, drift-immune signal is the WRN sentence AMBIG x2 -> ENCODED (cap-only 4->2). CAVEAT: encoded 3 -> 7 is NOT a controlled delta -- it accumulates span-integrity + the bare-mass And fix + this fix ACROSS intervening snapshot reseeds; against the last live-captured reranked run on the OLD snapshot (6914d01, encoded 7) this fix recovers the -1 the bare-mass run showed (6 -> 7). Floor set at 6 (see gates.faithfulness). Regression guards: dcg::lexicon::referential_definite_tests (CI, no snapshot) + definite_negation_collapses_referential (snapshot-gated, crates/eigenius-wordnet/tests/db_backed_encoding.rs).

RE-BASELINE. Quantifier-determiner fix. `several`/`many`/`few`/`most`/`both` were MISSING from the determiner lexicon, so `several cancers` had no quantifier reading and fell back to `several`'s WordNet gradable-ADJECTIVE entry used prenominally (`gt(deg_a, std_a)` -- the spurious 'more-several-than-standard' modifier). Two-part fix: (1) added the 5 as plural existential determiners (closed-class.esl, modeled on `some` but pl; cardinality opaque first-cut); (2) an ALWAYS-ON cross-POS prune (parse/seed.rs) that drops the open-class ADJECTIVE reading (`is_adjective_cat`, the S[adj]\NP seed) of any surface carrying a closed-class DETERMINER reading (`cat_forall`). Part 1 alone would leave determiner AND adjective (still 2); part 2 alone would gap the sentence (no quantifier reading) -- both needed. Bootstrap edit -> reseed --umls-all + v3-align -> wordnet-umls-aligned-v3-2026-07-16-quant (2.7 GB, image rebuilt). Witnessed: cap-only grammar-gap 0 + missing-lexeme 0, total readings 2899 -> 2835 (-64, adjective readings pruned corpus-wide), `several cancers` now 1 structural skeleton (determiner; both the gt-adjective and the noun-compound gone); reranked encoded 8, ambiguous 53, open 1, grammar-gap 0, runtime 248s. Traced drift-immune signal: `MSI contributes to several cancers` AMBIG x2 -> ENCODED (+1 over the definite-fix run's 7). No collateral: `most commonly observed` (most-as-adverb) and `fewer deletion` (fewer-as-determiner) unchanged; predicative adjective uses ('the problems were several') are given up by the prune (accepted -- these are quantifiers, not gradable properties). KNOWN RESIDUAL: `few`/`most`/`both` still carry a noun-compound reading (the prune targets adjectives, not nouns); `several`/`many` are clean (no competing noun sense at the cap). Floor set at 7 (see gates.faithfulness).
